issue.title: Document Project 4 board rules, Expo-first deps, and cross-tool agent entrypoints
issue.body:
### Problem statement

1. Agents reorganized Project 4 cards incorrectly (moved Dev Ready work, touched Product-owned columns). Board mutation rules need to live in repo docs/rules.
2. Cursor-only rules leave Claude Code / other AI tools without the same contract.
3. New dependencies should prefer Expo-maintained packages when an Expo option exists (e.g. Expo Router / Expo modules over community alternatives), consistent with SDK 56 CNG.

### Scope

- Document Project 4 board mutation do/don’t rules (canonical in `docs/`, Cursor always-on pointer).
- Add cross-tool entrypoints (`CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md` updates).
- Document Expo-first dependency preference for new work (navigation, modules, install via `npx expo install`).
- Do not migrate the app off `@react-navigation` in this PR — policy only.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Board mutation rules in committed docs + thin `.cursor/rules` pointer
- [ ] Expo-first package preference documented + Cursor rule
- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` point any agent tool at the same sources
- [ ] No Product-column cards mutated by this PR; no app navigation migration

### Verification

- [ ] Docs-only PR; note gate waiver if no code changed
